rows.same members: struct A { int a; char b; }; struct B { int x; char y; };
rows.cv on one member: struct A { int a; char b; }; struct B { const int x; volatile char y; };
rows.signed and unsigned: struct A { int a; }; struct B { unsigned x; };
rows.extra member: struct A { int a; char b; }; struct B { int x; char y; char z; };
rows.different alignment: struct A { int a; char b; }; struct B { alignas(8) int x; char y; };
rows.bit-fields same width: struct A { int a : 3; int b; }; struct B { int x : 3; int y; };
rows.bit-fields different width: struct A { int a : 3; int b; }; struct B { int x : 4; int y; };
rows.bit-field and plain member: struct A { int a : 32; }; struct B { int x; };
rows.zero-width bit-field in one: struct A { int a : 3; int : 0; int b : 3; }; struct B { int x : 3; int y : 3; };
rows.enumerations, same underlying type: enum class E1 : int { a }; enum E2 : int { b, c }; struct A { E1 a; }; struct B { E2 x; };
rows.enumeration and its underlying type: enum E1 : int { a }; struct A { E1 a; }; struct B { int x; };
rows.nested layout-compatible structs: struct P { int a; }; struct Q { int b; }; struct A { P p; char c; }; struct B { Q q; char d; };
rows.arrays of layout-compatible structs: struct P { int a; }; struct Q { int b; }; struct A { P p[2]; }; struct B { Q q[2]; };
rows.members from a base: struct Base { int a; char b; }; struct A : Base {}; struct B { int x; char y; };
rows.overlap mark on one: struct E {}; struct A { int a; [[no_unique_address]] E e; }; struct B { int x; E f; };
rows.overlap mark on both: struct E {}; struct A { int a; [[no_unique_address]] E e; }; struct B { int x; [[no_unique_address]] E f; };
rows.unions, members reordered: union A { int a; float b; }; union B { float x; int y; };
rows.unions, different count: union A { int a; float b; }; union B { float x; int y; char z; };
rows.struct and union: struct A { int a; }; union B { int x; };
rows.enum types direct: enum class E1 : short { a }; enum E2 : short { b }; using A = E1; using B = E2;
rows.int and const int: using A = int; using B = const int;
rows.int arrays: using A = int[2]; using B = int[2];
rows.struct arrays: struct P { int a; }; struct Q { int b; }; using A = P[2]; using B = Q[2];
rows.different access: struct A { int a; }; class B { public: int x; };
